property_summary: In C, every withdrawAll call from an EOA succeeds (the reentrancy lock is released after each call), whereas in the mutant the lock is never released so a second withdrawAll call always reverts; the test drives two deposit+withdrawAll sequences by two fuzzed EOAs and asserts the second withdrawal succeeds.
change_summary: Delete '__lock_modifier0_lock = false;' at the end of the modifier so the lock is never released and any subsequent withdrawAll reverts.
